name: web-process-slide-with-eight-blue-cards-and-steel-photos
title: Blue process board with project, goal and problem cards, tasks 1-4 and industrial photos
whatItIs: A deep blue rounded board '(04) Process' with a grid of lighter blue rounded cards: about the project, goal, problem, each with a white label pill, two photos of steel stock, and four task cards with numbered white circles and outlined pills.
whatItMeans: Organised and reliable; equal cards make a complex brief scannable.
techniques: Tile the brief as equal rounded cards.
Label each with a white pill.
Mix in real photos of the material.

vocabulary.definition: A card describing part of a brief.
A white capsule naming a card.
A white circle with a step number.
A card that is a photograph.
